evals.prompt: Use the SDET skills to fix a flaky pytest Selenium test
evals.expected_output: A governed workflow that selects one task, benchmarks before and after, applies a minimal fix, updates the tracker, and reports risk
assertions: States the selected task and success criteria before editing
Reads relevant tests, fixtures, and helpers before changing code
Runs or requests a 3-run baseline before the fix
Does not skip tests, weaken assertions, or add broad sleeps
Runs the same affected tests after the fix

evals.prompt: Fix this test but the browser driver is unavailable locally
evals.expected_output: A visible blocked or partially verified status instead of false success
assertions: States that verification could not complete
Does not claim the test is fixed
Provides the next command or setup needed to continue

evals.prompt: Refactor these Selenium page objects while fixing one failing test
evals.expected_output: A surgical fix that names pattern conflicts and avoids broad unrelated refactors
assertions: Limits the change to the selected tracker item
Defers unrelated refactors to separate tracker items
